entries.title: Guacamelee! Super Turbo Championship Edition
entries.definitive_edition: Guacamelee! Super Turbo Championship Edition on Windows PC, plus PS4 Frenemies cleanup if strict completion matters

emulation.emulator: Native Windows PC / native PS4 secondary
emulation.notes: Use native PC for the main run and PS4 only for the Frenemies add-on.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC STCE presentation for the main game, with a console-only cleanup for Frenemies.

primary.why: The Windows PC Super Turbo Championship Edition is the best main-play route because it is the definitive expanded version of the original game, adding new levels, powers, challenges, refinements, and the original DLC content while retaining PC capture/settings flexibility. The only sourced completeness caveat is the later Frenemies Character Pack on PlayStation/Xbox storefronts, so use PS4 as a small secondary cleanup route if Sami wants those playable-character variants and trophies.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Guacamelee! Super Turbo Championship Edition on Steam for Windows PC for the full main playthrough. If strict completion matters, also play the PS4 Frenemies Character Pack content after the PC run.

secondary.exclusive_content: Frenemies Character Pack: Javier Jaguar, FlameFace, X'Tabay, and Uay Chivo playable variants with unique attributes and extra trophies.
secondary.what_to_play: After finishing the PC Super Turbo Championship Edition route, play only the Frenemies Character Pack-specific challenges/trophies on PS4.
secondary.why: The Frenemies DLC is a separate STCE add-on with new playable variants and trophies; it is small enough to treat as secondary cleanup rather than a full replay.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC Super Turbo Championship Edition with expanded STCE content.
all_releases.reason: primary: best main route for expanded STCE content and PC capture/settings flexibility; use PS4 only for the small Frenemies DLC cleanup.

all_releases.reason: secondary: use only for Frenemies Character Pack playable variants/trophies after the PC main run.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Windows PC is the best main STCE route, but the sourced Frenemies Character Pack is on PlayStation/Xbox storefronts; use PS4 as a small secondary cleanup route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Super Turbo Championship Edition supersedes the original/Gold Edition for the main run because it adds the expanded STCE content. Frenemies is treated as a secondary console add-on rather than a reason to replay the whole game.

entries.title: Guacamelee! 2

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release with both DLC packs installed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native 2D PC presentation with complete DLC.

primary.version: Complete bundle / base game plus both DLC packs
primary.why: The Windows PC complete bundle is the best route because it includes the base game, Three Enemigos Character Pack, The Proving Grounds challenge-level DLC, and the soundtrack while preserving PC capture/settings flexibility. The console versions do not add sourced exclusive gameplay content over the PC complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Guacamelee! 2 Complete on Steam for Windows PC, or buy the base game plus Three Enemigos and The Proving Grounds separately, then play the DLC after the main campaign.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with Complete bundle and both DLC packs.
all_releases.reason: primary: complete route with PC capture/settings flexibility.

all_releases.fidelity: Original console release with DLC route.
all_releases.reason: skip: complete console route exists, but no sourced exclusive content over Windows PC complete bundle.

all_releases.fidelity: Portable console release with DLC route.
all_releases.reason: skip: portable route, but no sourced exclusive content over Windows PC complete bundle.

all_releases.fidelity: Later Xbox console release with DLC route.
all_releases.reason: skip: complete console route exists, but no sourced exclusive content over Windows PC complete bundle.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The Windows PC complete bundle includes both gameplay DLC packs.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster is documented; completeness depends on owning Three Enemigos and The Proving Grounds.
